title: Hello World
prompt: Write a program that uses a print function to say 'hello world' as shown in Desired Output.
learning_objective: Use Python's print() function to display a simple greeting string.
hint: Look carefully at the starter: print is misspelled. Fix the function name and keep the quoted string.
solution_explanation: The fix is a one-character typo: rename prinq to print so Python calls the built-in print function with the string hello world.

student.py.starter:
# the code below almost works
prinq("hello world")

OutputTests.test_desired_output.title: Matches desired output
OutputTests.test_desired_output.feedback: Compare your program output carefully to the Desired Output.

SourceTests.test_source_print.title: Source check: require 'print'
SourceTests.test_source_print.feedback: You must use a print function.
